title: Awesome AI Apps
tagline: 100+ runnable RAG, agent, and workflow demos — many powered by Nebius Token Factory
description: A large, actively maintained collection of production-style AI apps covering RAG, multi-agent systems, and workflows. Numerous starter and advanced examples run on Nebius Token Factory via langchain-nebius (ChatNebius, NebiusEmbeddings), including dedicated Nebius chat, LangChain/LangGraph/AutoGen/Mastra starters, a LlamaIndex RAG starter, a travel planner, and a deep-research writing agent.

title: All Agentic Architectures
tagline: 35 production-grade agent patterns (Reflexion, LATS, GraphRAG, MemGPT) with Nebius as the default LLM provider
description: A Python library and runnable textbook implementing 35 agentic AI architectures with a 17-task benchmark leaderboard. Nebius is the default LLM and embedding backend via langchain-nebius (ChatNebius, NebiusEmbeddings), running Llama-3.3-70B and Qwen3-Thinking out of the box.

title: Nebius Llama-3 Multi-Tool Agent (Marktechpost)
tagline: Multi-tool ReAct agent tutorial built on Nebius AI Studio with ChatNebius, NebiusEmbeddings, and NebiusRetriever
description: Part of Marktechpost's large AI-agents tutorial collection, this notebook builds a multi-tool Llama-3 agent end to end on Nebius. It uses langchain-nebius components — ChatNebius for Llama-3.3-70B, plus NebiusEmbeddings and NebiusRetriever — to wire reasoning, retrieval, and tool calling into one runnable agent.

title: Temporal AI Agent Pipeline
tagline: Time-aware knowledge-graph ingestion pipeline using Nebius for embeddings and DeepSeek-V3
description: An agentic pipeline that turns raw documents (such as financial earnings calls) into structured, time-aware knowledge graphs with semantic chunking, atomic fact extraction, entity resolution, and temporal invalidation. It generates embeddings with Qwen3-Embedding-8B through Nebius (langchain-nebius) and runs DeepSeek-V3 via Nebius for the extraction steps.

title: Gen-AI Experiments
tagline: 130+ generative-AI notebooks including a LoRA fine-tuning guide on Nebius Token Factory
description: A broad collection of generative-AI applications, agents, and educational notebooks spanning LangChain, CrewAI, and LlamaIndex. It includes a dedicated 'Fine-Tuning LLMs with Nebius TokenFactory' notebook that walks through LoRA fine-tuning of custom models on the Nebius platform.

title: Nebius Slurm ML Training and Inference Demo
tagline: Distributed LLM fine-tuning and vLLM serving on a Soperator Slurm-on-Kubernetes cluster
description: An end-to-end demo that fine-tunes Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B across 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs on a Nebius Cloud cluster, then serves the models with vLLM. The cluster is deployed via Terraform using the Soperator (Slurm-on-Kubernetes) template from the Nebius Solutions Library, with InfiniBand GPUDirect RDMA interconnect.

title: MCP Server on Nebius Serverless
tagline: Claude Desktop MCP server that forwards tool calls to Token Factory embeddings
description: An MCP server deployed on Nebius Serverless Endpoints that receives tool calls from Claude Desktop and forwards them to Nebius Token Factory for text embeddings. It uses the Qwen3-Embedding-8B model to produce 4096-dimensional vectors, demonstrating a serverless embedding bridge with low latency.

title: Clinical-RAG
tagline: Citation-backed medical RAG with Nebius as a pluggable LLM and embedding provider
description: A production-oriented clinical RAG system that answers questions from CDC and WHO guidelines with strict citation enforcement, hybrid semantic search over Milvus, and safety guardrails. Its backend wires Nebius through langchain-nebius — ChatNebius for generation and NebiusEmbeddings for retrieval — alongside other configurable providers.

title: Lattice
tagline: Opinionated deep-research agent for physics PhD work, running tools on Nebius
description: A LangChain/LangGraph deep-research agent tailored for a solid-state physics PhD student. It uses ChatNebius from langchain-nebius as its tool-using model, configured through a dedicated Nebius model settings module and NEBIUS_API_KEY.

title: Cheki-Bot Server
tagline: FastAPI + LangChain conversational AI with a dedicated Nebius agent and embeddings
description: A conversational AI server built with FastAPI and LangChain Core, offering Telegram webhook and WebSocket chat plus vector-database retrieval. It ships a dedicated NebiusAgent class and uses langchain-nebius (ChatNebius and NebiusEmbeddings) as a first-class multi-LLM provider.

title: Botcachino
tagline: FastAPI + LangGraph university-info agent with Nebius as the default LLM provider
description: A news and information-retrieval system with a FastAPI backend, React frontend, and a LangGraph agent for university information, backed by PostgreSQL vector search. Nebius is the default model provider, configured via langchain-nebius with NebiusEmbeddings for semantic search and ChatNebius for the agent.

title: LangGraph Customer-Service Data Analyst
tagline: ReAct data-analyst agent over the Bitext support dataset, served by Token Factory
description: A LangGraph ReAct agent that answers questions about the Bitext customer-support dataset by routing queries and invoking seven data-analysis tools, with SQLite-checkpoint memory and an MCP interface. Both the agent and its router run Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct through the Nebius OpenAI-compatible Token Factory endpoint.

title: Nebius SpecimenAI
tagline: Fine-tuned biomedical specimen-triage agent built on Token Factory
description: A biomedical specimen-triage system that generates training data, runs a LoRA fine-tune of Llama-3.1-8B on Nebius Token Factory, and orchestrates an autonomous agent that combines triage classification with tool-calling to route specimens. Built as a hands-on Token Factory workshop covering fine-tuning, structured output, tool calling, and production logging.

title: Job Finder Agent (MCP Server)
tagline: LinkedIn-to-jobs agent using Nebius AI Studio Llama-3.3-70B for analysis
description: An AI job-search agent that analyzes a LinkedIn profile, classifies domain expertise, and matches it against Y Combinator startup roles with direct application links. It pairs Bright Data web scraping with Nebius AI Studio (Llama-3.3-70B) for the intelligent analysis and is exposed as an MCP server.

title: GitHub Repo Analyzer
tagline: FastAPI service that summarizes any repo with Llama-3.3-70B on Token Factory
description: A FastAPI service that takes a public GitHub repository URL and returns a structured summary with a description, detected technologies, and the project's file structure. It runs Llama-3.3-70B via the Nebius OpenAI-compatible Token Factory API for reliable structured-JSON code summarization.

title: Talk-to-DB
tagline: Natural-language database agent powered by ChatNebius
description: A natural-language-to-database tool that lets users query a database through an LLM agent. Its agent layer is built with langchain-nebius, instantiating ChatNebius as the reasoning model behind the query workflow.

title: PregGo
tagline: Maternal-health emergency assistant with a Nebius-powered consultation chatbot
description: A maternal-healthcare web app that helps pregnant women in emergencies by locating nearby hospitals with bed availability, identifying on-duty staff, and maintaining medical histories. Its consultation chatbot is powered by langchain-nebius, using ChatNebius for guidance and NebiusEmbeddings for retrieval.

title: IChatClient with Nebius Token Factory
tagline: .NET console chat sample wiring Microsoft.Extensions.AI to Token Factory
description: A C#/.NET sample that connects the Microsoft.Extensions.AI IChatClient abstraction to Nebius Token Factory. It points the OpenAI-compatible endpoint at the Token Factory base URL, giving .NET developers a minimal working example of chatting with open-source models on Nebius.
